text:
morgan: quick debate  do we treat explicit `X-Billing-Project` header as authoritative for quota attribution, or prefer token-claim billing project? support keeps seeing mismatches.

teo: prioritize token_claim > header. headers are easier to spoof. but we should show `billing_assertion_source` in Console so it's obvious.

anya: agreed on precedence. UX suggestion: top-line show `billing_project (source)` e.g. `proj-9 (token_claim)`. expand for policy and matched key.

morgan: ok. telemetry-wise emit a compact record with `billing_assertion_source` and `policy_version`. sample full-policy 0.5% by default. example payload:
```json
{
  "policy_name": "billing-first",
  "policy_version": "v7",
  "matched_scope": "project",
  "billing_project": "proj-9",
  "billing_assertion_source": "token_claim",
  "quota_bucket": "write-heavy",
  "sampled": "false"
}
```

teo: also add an analytic `console.billing_mismatch_reported` event when a user files a billing mismatch from the Console so we can correlate with policy changes.

ops-bot: deploy queued: web-console v3.20.1 -> canary (flag: console.show_billing_source) ETA 8m.

anya: security note: hash any matcher ids before storing, and require `view_sensitive_audit` to unmask. log unmask events.

morgan: will draft tiny RFC with precedence rule, telemetry fields, and UI snippet. linking once ready. :thumbsup:
